newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NSW narrows bids for A$188 mln Olympic tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NSW narrows bids for A$188 mln Olympic tender.

text.p: The New South Wales state government said on Thursday it had narrowed to three the number of groups bidding for an A$188 million contract to build a sports and entertainment centre for the Sydney Olympics.

Minister for the Olympics Michael Knight said the move followed an evaluation of expressions of interest from five consortia to design, build and operate the centre, to be situated at Homebush Bay, north of the Olympic Stadium.
The contract is the fourth largest being awarded in the run-up to Sydney hosting the Olympic games in 2000, a spokesman for the minister said.
He said the contract would be awarded next year.

The groups shortlisted for the contract are Millennium Consortium, which includes Daewoo Engineering and Construction Australia and Macquarie Bank; SA2000 Events Consortium, comprising in part Hambros Australia and Multiplex Construction; and Sydney Coliseum Consortium, including Leighton Properties and Bain and Co, the minister's office said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
